subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

One who hates or discriminates against women.
solution: The correct answer is **'Misogynist.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **'Misogynist'** means a person who hates or discriminates against women. (स्त्रियों से घृणा करनेवाला, नारी-द्वेषी, पुरुष संबंधी) • **Example**:* He is a **misogynist**__ who always belittles women and their capabilities.* • The word is derived from Greek words **'misos' **meaning **hatred** and** 'gyne' **meaning **woman**. • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2 - 'Pessimist'** means a person who always sees the negative side of things.(निराशावादी व्‍यक्ति) • **Option 3 - 'Feminist' **means a person who believes in equal rights and opportunities for women. (एक व्यक्ति जो महिलाओं के लिए समान अधिकारों और अवसरों में विश्वास करता है) • **Option 4 - 'Atheist'** means a person who does not believe in the existence of God or deities. (नास्तिक, निरीश्‍वरवादी) 40:Ta73, The correct answer is **"Hurricane."**
